name: Receiptgen – Receipt & Invoice Generator
author: receiptgenerator

sections.description:
Two tools, two shortcodes. Everything runs in the visitor’s browser; nothing is uploaded to your server.

Receiptgen Receipts – [rcptgn_receipt]

  • 240+ templates in 25 categories with live search and category tabs
  • Live preview: merchant, logo, transaction, extra details, line items with discounts, multiple tax lines, tip, footer message
  • 42 languages with a visitor language switcher (full list below)
  • Right-to-left layout for Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Hebrew, Pashto and Sindhi, in the preview and in every download
  • Dates, times and money follow each language’s format
  • All active world currencies (ISO 4217)
  • 14 receipt styles, including Till slip, Modern, Classic, Bold, Minimal, Classic invoice, Blue medical, Red sidebar, Simple form, Modern banner and four rent-receipt grids, with brand colors
  • Theme: 6 paper colors and 5 receipt fonts
  • Download PNG, JPG, or PDF, or print
  • Share to Gmail (downloads the PDF, then opens an email ready for it) and WhatsApp (downloads the image, then opens WhatsApp)
  • No watermark. An optional footer line “Made with [name]” is off by default; enter a name under Settings > Receiptgen Receipts to turn it on
  • Loads only on pages that use the shortcode. Export libraries load only when a download, print, or share button is used
  • All receipt data stays in the visitor’s browser. Nothing is uploaded to your server

Receiptgen Invoices – [rcptgn_invoice template="taxi-invoice"]

  • Live paper preview that updates as you type
  • One-click PDF download (A4 or US Letter), PNG image download, print view, and Share (sends the PDF straight to WhatsApp, Gmail or any app on mobile)
  • 60+ templates with fields for each job: taxi trip details, rental period, hotel stay, GST details, shipping details for commercial invoices, and more
  • Logo upload, 60 currencies, discount, one or two taxes (e.g. CGST + SGST), shipping, amount paid and balance due
  • Payment terms (Due on receipt, Net 7 to Net 60, or a custom date) with automatic due date
  • Invoice language switch with 30 languages. Dates and money are formatted for the chosen language, and Arabic, Urdu, Persian and Hebrew print right-to-left
  • 60 currencies
  • Seven layouts (Classic, Modern, Minimal, Sidebar, Boxed, Bold, Elegant) with thumbnails
  • 12 preset colors plus any custom color. Text switches to dark on light colors so it stays readable, optional “Paid” stamp
  • Remembers the user’s business details in their own browser only
  • Private by design: no data is sent to your server, no account needed
  • Assets load only on pages that use the shortcode

Receipt shortcode options

[rcptgn_receipt]
[rcptgn_receipt template=”restaurant-receipt”] Preloads a template (ID = template name in lowercase with dashes)
[rcptgn_receipt category=”food”] Opens the template browser on that category
[rcptgn_receipt lang=”ur”] Opens the tool in that language (any code from the list below)
[rcptgn_receipt style=”modern”] Opens with a receipt style: slip, modern, classic, bold or minimal
[rcptgn_templates] Template bar only. The editor opens below it after a visitor picks a template or clicks Start from Scratch

Category keys: fuel, driver, helper, rent, book, net, food, lta, ecom, gen, rch, med, sta, cab, mart, gym, hotel, news, shop, auto, homes, care, pets, pro, pay

Invoice shortcode attributes

  • template – which template to load (default: invoice)
  • currency – ISO code such as USD, PKR, INR, AED, GBP, EUR
  • accent – hex color, e.g. #1d6b57
  • style – classic, modern, minimal, sidebar, boxed, bold or elegant
  • paper – a4 or letter
  • lang – invoice language code, e.g. en, es, pt, fr, de, it, nl, tr, ar, ur, hi, id, ru, uk, pl, cs, ro, sv, el, vi, th, ms, tl, zh, ja, ko, bn, fa, he, sw
  • title – override the document title shown on the paper

Example:
[rcptgn_invoice template=”gst-invoice-format” currency=”INR” style=”modern”]

Adding your own invoice templates

Use the rcptgn_iv_templates filter in your theme’s functions.php:

add_filter( ‘rcptgn_iv_templates’, function ( $t ) {
$t[‘bakery-invoice’] = rcptgn_iv_tpl( array(
‘name’ => ‘Bakery invoice’,
‘items’ => array( array( ‘Birthday cake, 2 kg’, 1, 45 ) ),
) );
return $t;
} );

Receipt languages

Settings > Receiptgen Receipts: default language (or match the visitor’s browser), show or hide the switcher, and pick which languages appear in it.
Order of priority: shortcode lang attribute, then the visitor’s last choice, then the site default.

Add a language: copy receipt/assets/js/i18n/rcptgn-rc-lang-it.js to rcptgn-rc-lang-{code}.js, translate the values, and add one line to rcptgn_rc_languages() in receipt/module.php.

Language codes: en, ar, bg, bn, cs, da, de, el, es, fa, fi, fil, fr, he, hi, hr, hu, id, it, ja, ko, mr, ms, nl, no, pa, pl, ps, pt, ro, ru, sd, sk, sr, sv, sw, ta, tr, uk, ur, vi, zh.

Template names stay in English. Categories, the interface and the receipt labels are translated.

External services

This plugin does not call any external service and sends no data to any server. Receipts and invoices are built in the visitor’s browser. The Gmail and WhatsApp share buttons open a link in a new tab only when the visitor clicks them:

  • Gmail: https://mail.google.com/mail/ with a pre-filled subject. Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • WhatsApp: https://wa.me/ with a pre-filled message. Privacy policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy

The file itself is never uploaded; the visitor attaches the downloaded file. The visitor’s language choice and saved business details are kept in their own browser (localStorage). No cookies are set.

Third-party libraries (bundled)

Minified files in receipt/assets/vendor/ are unmodified official releases. Source:

  • html2canvas 1.4.1 (MIT): https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas
  • jsPDF 2.5.2 (MIT): https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF
  • JsBarcode 3.11.6 (MIT): https://github.com/lindell/JsBarcode
  • Fonts under SIL Open Font License: Courier Prime, IBM Plex Mono, Space Mono, VT323, Noto Naskh Arabic, Noto Sans (Devanagari, Mono Greek, Hebrew, Bengali, Gurmukhi, Tamil)

The invoice tool uses its own export engine (invoice/assets/js/export.js) and no third-party library.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ (or use Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin).
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Add [rcptgn_receipt] or [rcptgn_invoice] to any page or post.
  4. Optional: set defaults under Settings > Receiptgen Receipts and Settings > Receiptgen Invoices.
sections.faq:
Is data sent to my server or anyone else?

No. Everything is built in the visitor’s browser.

Does it add a credit line?

Not by default. Receipts print “Made with [name]” only if you enter a name in Settings > Receiptgen Receipts. Invoices show a credit line only if you tick “Credit line on PDF” in Settings > Receiptgen Invoices.

PDF download does not work.

Make sure a firewall or optimizer is not blocking files in the plugin folder. Settings > Receiptgen Invoices has a System check with a test PDF button.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release: receipt generator and invoice generator in one plugin.
  • Receipt footer credit is off by default.
  • No scripts load from third-party hosts.
  • Uninstall removes both settings.
